description: For a partner, reseller, OEM or Enterprise group account: maintenance across every account it services. Returns counters (in maintenance, scheduled, overdue, open problems, open alerts, out of order, accounts needing a visit), one row per serviced account (printers, open problems, overdue jobs, next scheduled job, next visit, agreement), the most recent open problems, and the accounts due a visit. Fails on an account that is not a partner with the maintenance module.
name: get_partner_maintenance_overview
